title: Budget and expenses
audience: For anyone who wants to know where the money went without a budgeting app.
description: A free budget and expense tracker in a note: what's left this month, spending by category, quick add. Or tell your AI what you spent and it logs it.
tagline: What you spend, against a monthly budget.
seoTitle: Budget tracker template and app for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Budget and expenses

Set your monthly budget in the app, then add what you spend. Or tell your AI what you spent and it logs it. Amounts are in your own currency.

## Month summaries
Ask your AI to sum up a month, and its lines land here.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Budget and expenses". It is an app; its data is "Budget and expenses.app/data.json", beside the note. Read it with fetch before each change. If values.started isn't set, its categories are only suggestions: ask what I can spend a month and on what, write values.categories as { name, budget }, and set values.currency and values.started (today, yyyy-mm-dd). When I say what I spent, add { id, date, what, category, amount } to values.expenses with edit, with a category from values.categories. A monthly bill goes in values.recurring as { id, what, category, amount, day }. When I ask about a month, say what was over its budget, what was under, and one suggestion. No other financial advice.

asks: Ask what I can spend a month and on what, then set up my budget.
How am I doing against the budget this month?
What did we spend on eating out last month?

args.old_string: Ask your AI to sum up a month, and its lines land here.
args.new_string:
Ask your AI to sum up a month, and its lines land here.
**Last month:** 5,925 kr of 6,300 kr. Groceries came to 3,945 kr of 4,000 kr and eating out to 1,190 kr of 1,500 kr. One month of the last six went over, by 380 kr. Suggestion: the grocery budget is tight but it holds, so leave it.
